reason: The helper has high cyclomatic complexity (13) and low maintainability index (19.89), yet it is only called once in the library and rarely touched. Its logic is tangled: environment handling, color detection, subprocess creation, and cleanup are all in one block, making it error‑prone and hard to test. Refactoring will reduce complexity, improve testability, and lower the risk of future bugs.
action: Split the function into smaller, focused helpers: 1) a function to build the environment and determine the color flag; 2) a function to launch the subprocess and return the stdin stream; 3) a cleanup routine that closes stdin and waits for the process, handling KeyboardInterrupt and BrokenPipeError. Replace the while‑True loop with a simple try/except around c.wait(), and use contextlib.ExitStack to manage resources. Add type hints and a concise docstring for each helper.
